method: Manual native UI / accessibility / visual inspection in the user's existing signed-in Brave; real ChatGPT documents, no synthetic fixtures.

checks.observed: Conversation B indexed 5 current prompts, including image placeholders.

checks.name: Case-insensitive English search

checks.name: SPA active-conversation selection
checks.observed: Sidebar navigation between the two real conversations cleared search and replaced directory after new content loaded; hidden previous page excluded.

checks.name: Explicit history scanning

checks.name: Escape stops loading

checks.name: Virtualized cached target recovery

checks.name: Reading position restoration
checks.observed: After completed history scan, the original recent target question was again visible at the saved reading position.

checks.name: Refresh initialization
checks.observed: Multiple real page refreshes recreated a single navigator and rebuilt current loaded-message index.

checks.name: Final long-turn optimization and second browser tab
checks.observed: After final source reload, one scan grew index from 5 to 45 (40 new), reported current page top, and returned to original prompt. Other existing real tab refreshed and indexed 5 prompts; returning preserved the 45-entry index.
